summary: camelot-ammv2-periphery exfiltrates installer credentials to webhook.site on npm install
details: Typosquat of the Camelot DEX periphery contracts package. The tarball ships no Solidity contracts; instead package.json declares both preinstall and postinstall as `node index.js || true`, guaranteeing execution on `npm install`. index.js filters process.env by a credential/wallet regex (KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PRIVATE|MNEMONIC|AWS|GITHUB|NPM|WALLET|INFURA|ALCHEMY,...), reads installer-owned secret paths including ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_*, ~/.kube, ~/.docker, ~/.netrc, ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc, ~/.gitconfig, gcloud config, Solana/NEAR/Sui/Foundry keystores, and local.env files, collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.platform()), and POSTs a JSON blob via https.request to webhook.site/326b0891-2093-4800-a4c1-686ce3e07b09.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
